personal.bio: CISO with 25+ years building security programs across fintech, payments, and regulated online gaming. Board-reporting executive accountable for $2M+ in security and IT spend, with programs spanning 50+ countries and more than a dozen regulators. No material incidents under my leadership; 72+ regulatory audits passed. I build security programs that survive audits and enable business growth.

Accountable for $2M+ annual security, IT, and technology vendor spend
Functional accountability across security, risk, compliance, corporate IT, and resilience
Regulatory engagement with FCA, NBB (DORA), CBUAE, DFSA, VARA, MAS, NYDFS, US state regulators, Finansinspektionen (PSD2), and gaming authorities (UKGC, AAMS, MGA, AGCC, CCC)
Delivered and maintained SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and PCI DSS Level 1; no material incidents under leadership; 72+ regulatory audits passed
